content_sections.heading: KSRLPS Job Profile 2026
content_sections.text: This role supports skill development activities under DDU-GKY at the cluster level. Core responsibilities include community mobilization, coordination with Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs), candidate counseling and selection support, monitoring of training batches, and post-placement tracking of candidates, with particular attention to tracking female candidates. This role focuses on building and strengthening community institutions at the cluster level. Responsibilities include field visits, organizing women and vulnerable communities into functional institutions, facilitating livelihoods planning and micro-credit activities, coordinating entitlement delivery through government schemes, MIS data entry, and liaison with Panchayati Raj Institutions and line departments. This role coordinates farm livelihood activities across the district. Responsibilities include liaison with block and cluster-level Farm Livelihoods staff, inter-department convergence, planning and monitoring farm livelihoods activities, capacity building for project staff and community members, developing protocols for organic farming, and identifying institutional or local buyers for produce.

content_sections.text: As per the official notification, candidates are shortlisted through an Interview . The job portal does not list any additional written test stage beyond application submission and screening.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies in total: 4 for Cluster Supervisor - Skill, 3 for Cluster Supervisor, and 1 for District Manager - Farm Livelihood.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Is Cluster Supervisor - Skill the same as Cluster Supervisor?
faq.answer: No. They are two separate posts with different job responsibilities, experience requirements, and taluka-wise vacancies, though both carry the same salary of Rs. 18,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for District Manager - Farm Livelihood?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc (Agriculture) with 2+ years of experience, or B.Sc (Agriculture) with 4+ years, or M.Sc/Environmental Science with 7+ years, or any other Master's degree with 7+ years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 50 years of age for all three posts.
